Greedy by max frequency. O(n).

For task scheduler idle I will arrange max-freq tasks first.

```python
from collections import Counter
def schedule(tasks, n):
    c = Counter(tasks)
    mf = max(c.values())
    idle = (mf - 1) * n
    for v in c.values():
        idle -= min(mf - 1, v)
    return len(tasks) + max(0, idle)
```
